application_credentials.description: Create an application at the [Kroger developer portal]({developer_url}) with the scopes `product.compact`, `cart.basic:write` and `profile.compact`, and set its redirect URI to `{redirect_uri}`. Then enter its client ID and client secret here. Complete the Kroger sign-in on a computer; on phones the app-to-browser switch often loses it.

store.title: Find your store
store.description: Enter a ZIP code to find nearby Kroger-family stores. Stock levels and aisles come from this store. Each store is listed with its street address, because Kroger's store names don't always match the city.

data_description.zip_code: Five-digit US ZIP code near your store.

data_description.location_id: The store your cart orders from.

data_description.modality: How items pushed to your cart will be fulfilled.

reauth_confirm.title: Authentication expired for {name}
reauth_confirm.description: Your Kroger sign-in has expired. Sign in again to keep syncing your list. Complete the sign-in on a computer; on phones it often fails.

user.title: Sign in to Kroger
user.description:
Next you'll sign in to your Kroger account in a new window and approve access.

**Complete the Kroger sign-in on a computer.** On phones, the switch between the Home Assistant app and the browser often loses the sign-in.

You need a Kroger developer app's client ID and secret (see the README); you'll be asked for them if you haven't added them yet.

error.no_stores: No stores found near that ZIP code.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.oauth_unauthorized: OAuth authorization error while obtaining access token.
abort.missing_configuration: The component is not configured. Please follow the documentation.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, [check the help section]({docs_url})
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Kroger account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up with.

data_description.modality: How items pushed to your cart will be fulfilled.
data_description.order_days: Days you place your order. Leave empty to push back-in-stock items right away.
data_description.lead_time_days: How many days before an order day held items are pushed.
data_description.stock_check_hours: How often waiting items are checked for stock.
data_description.give_up_days: Flag an item for review after it has been waiting this many days. Items are never removed automatically.
data_description.debounce_seconds: Ignore repeat scans of the same code within this many seconds.
data_description.notify_targets: Mobile app notify actions to alert when items come back in stock.
data_description.notify_scans: Send one short push per scan or add to the notification targets (e.g. "✓ In cart: Milk 1 gal · Aisle 12"). Rapid scans replace each other instead of stacking. Useful for a looping iPhone Shortcut.

store.title: Find your store
store.description: Enter a ZIP code to find nearby Kroger-family stores. Stock levels and aisles come from this store. Each store is listed with its street address, because Kroger's store names don't always match the city.

data_description.zip_code: Five-digit US ZIP code near your store.

data_description.location_id: The store your cart orders from.

printing.title: Printing
printing.description: Both printouts group items by aisle, then list waiting and needs-review items.

data_description.receipt_host: IP address or hostname of an ESC/POS network printer. Leave empty if you don't have one.
data_description.ipp_url: For example ipp://printer.local/ipp/print. Leave empty to only save the PDF.
data_description.save_pdf: Keep a copy of every PDF in the media folder.

orders.title: Order tracking
orders.description: Kroger's API can't read orders, so order status comes from Kroger's order emails. Set up a separate IMAP connection for them (folder: a Kroger label, search: FROM "e.krogermail.com"), then pick it here.

data_description.imap_entry: The IMAP connection for the mailbox Kroger emails, shown with its folder and search so connections to the same account can be told apart. Leave empty to turn order tracking off.
data_description.notify_orders: Notify when an order is ready, out for delivery, cancelled, or missing items. Uses the notification targets from Settings.
data_description.extra_sender_domains: Only needed if your order emails come from a sender that isn't recognized. Comma-separated domains or full addresses, e.g. ralphsmail.com or orders@e.ralphsmail.com. Kroger's own order emails (email@e.krogermail.com) are already recognized.

orders_confirm.title: This IMAP connection may miss order emails
orders_confirm.description:
{warnings}

Submit to use it anyway, or close this dialog and fix the IMAP connection's options first.

cart_check.title: Pre-order cart check
cart_check.description: Kroger's API can't read your cart. Before each order day you get a notification listing what Home Assistant thinks is in the Kroger cart, with buttons to confirm it matches or record anything that's missing from Home Assistant. It never changes the cart.

data.cart_check_day: Day (when no order days are set)
data.cart_check_time: Time (when no order days are set)

data_description.cart_check_hours_before: Counted back from the start (midnight) of each order day set in Settings. 6 = 6 pm the evening before.
data_description.cart_check_day: Used only if no order days are set: the check goes out weekly on this day.
data_description.cart_check_time: Used only if no order days are set.

error.invalid_ipp_url: Enter a URL starting with ipp://, ipps://, http:// or https://.

not_check_cart.message: That item isn't waiting for a cart check (it's {status}).

auth_expired.description: Kroger stopped accepting the saved sign-in for {title}. Open Settings → Devices & services and re-authenticate Kroger Restock. Scans are still added to the list but cannot reach your cart until you do.

gave_up.title: {name} has been out of stock for {days} days

init.title: {name} is still out of stock
init.description: It has been waiting {days} days. Keep it on the list and keep checking, or remove it.

check_cart.title: {name} may already be in your Kroger cart

init.title: Is {name} in your Kroger cart?
init.description: Home Assistant stopped (or lost contact with Kroger) while adding {quantity} × {name} to your cart, so it can't tell whether it got there. Check your cart in the Kroger app, then choose:

menu_options.push_again: It's not in the cart: push again

imap_baseline.title: Order tracking is paused: couldn't read the order-email folder
imap_baseline.description: Before acting on any order email, Kroger Restock records the messages already in the folder as seen, so your order history is never processed. It couldn't read the folder of {imap} ({error}), so no order emails are being processed. It retries every 5 minutes; check the IMAP connection's credentials and folder.

scan_upc.name: Scan barcode
scan_upc.description: Adds a product by scanned barcode, Kroger product ID or kroger.com link. In-stock products are pushed to the Kroger cart; out-of-stock products wait on the list; unknown codes are added as unmatched.

upc.name: Barcode
upc.description: The scanned UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-13 or produce PLU code. Give one of Barcode, Product ID or Link.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Kroger Restock entry to use. Only needed if you have more than one.

already_in_cart.name: Already in cart
already_in_cart.description: The item is already in your Kroger cart (for example, added in the Kroger app). It's recorded as in the cart and nothing is sent to Kroger.

product_id.name: Product ID
product_id.description: A 13-digit Kroger product ID, looked up directly (no barcode guessing).

url.name: Link
url.description: A kroger.com (or Kroger-family banner) product link, or shared text containing one. The product ID is taken from the link.

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Adds an item by name. Searches the store's catalog; a single clear match is handled like a scan, otherwise the item is flagged for review.

name.name: Name
name.description: What to add, e.g. "Greek yogurt". Give a name or a link.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Kroger Restock entry to use. Only needed if you have more than one.

already_in_cart.name: Already in cart
already_in_cart.description: The item is already in your Kroger cart (for example, added in the Kroger app). It's recorded as in the cart and nothing is sent to Kroger.

url.name: Link
url.description: A kroger.com (or Kroger-family banner) product link, or shared text containing one. The product ID is taken from the link.

resolve_item.name: Resolve item
resolve_item.description: Fixes an unmatched or needs-review item by attaching a Kroger product. The barcode is remembered for future scans.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: The list item's ID (from the scan response or the item's attributes).

product_id.name: Product ID
product_id.description: The 13-digit Kroger product ID, or the product's UPC.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Kroger Restock entry to use. Only needed if you have more than one.

already_in_cart.name: Already in cart
already_in_cart.description: The item is already in your Kroger cart (for example, added in the Kroger app). It's recorded as in the cart and nothing is sent to Kroger.

sync.name: Sync cart
sync.description: Pushes any in-cart items whose cart push is still pending. Units already pushed are never sent again.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Kroger Restock entry to use. Only needed if you have more than one.

readd_item.name: Re-add item
readd_item.description: Puts an item back on the list and pushes it to the cart again after a stock check. Use it when an order was shorted at pickup. This is the only way an item already pushed is pushed again.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: The list item's ID (from the scan response or the item's attributes).

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Kroger Restock entry to use. Only needed if you have more than one.

check_stock.name: Check stock
check_stock.description: Re-checks every waiting item now. Items back in stock are pushed to the cart, or held until the order window if order days are set.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Kroger Restock entry to use. Only needed if you have more than one.

print_list.name: Print list
print_list.description: Prints the list grouped by aisle, with waiting and needs-review sections, to the receipt printer, as a letter-size PDF, or both. PDFs are saved to /media/kroger_restock and sent to the IPP printer if one is set.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Kroger Restock entry to use. Only needed if you have more than one.

mark_cart_received.name: Mark cart received
mark_cart_received.description: Marks the items in the cart as received after an order is picked up or delivered. List anything that didn't arrive (out of stock or replaced at the last minute) under Missing: those go back on the list, get a stock check and are pushed to the cart again for your next order.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Kroger Restock entry to use. Only needed if you have more than one.

missing.name: Missing
missing.description: Items that were expected but didn't arrive: list item IDs or names, e.g. "eggs, milk".

check_cart_item.name: Settle an unconfirmed cart item
check_cart_item.description: For an item whose cart push was interrupted (it may or may not be in your Kroger cart): confirm it's in the cart, push it again, or remove it from the list. Check the Kroger app first.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: The list item's ID (from the scan response or the item's attributes).

action.name: Action
action.description: confirm = it's in the cart (no cart call); push_again = it isn't, push it now; remove = take it off the list.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Kroger Restock entry to use. Only needed if you have more than one.

cart_check.name: Send cart check
cart_check.description: Sends the pre-order cart check now: what Home Assistant believes is in your Kroger cart, with buttons to confirm or record missing items. Returns the same list. Never changes the cart.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Kroger Restock entry to use. Only needed if you have more than one.
